- Run both strategies end to end through the engine and reproduce the result object from disk.
- State the sequence of the event loop from memory, including what each step is allowed to read.

## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Arithmetic, timed, twenty-first sitting. Ten two-digit multiplications, the sevenths, and 17 times 18, 23 times 27 and 34 times 36 using the complements trick.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Markov chains: a mouse in a 3 by 3 grid of rooms moves to a uniformly chosen adjacent room each minute, starting in a corner. Expected time to reach the centre? Set up the states using symmetry so there are three, not nine.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> The follow-up: what is the long-run fraction of time spent in the centre? Get it from the stationary distribution and say why it is proportional to the number of doors.
:::
:::
